thread:
maria: Heads-up - new CVE batch hitting upstream: kubelet CVE-2025-0451 (privilege escalation, CVSS 7.8) and cert-manager CVE-2025-1183 (AC build-time validation). Need triage for priority and whether we do an emergency patch window or scheduled upgrade. Any blockers for RBAC or KMS interactions?
jonathan: I skimmed both. kubelet one requires kubelet kubeadm patch; affects node bootstrap path. For our Dedicated clusters risk is moderate-high because some internal tooling writes node annotations. Should prioritize. cert-manager looks exploitable only if unvalidated webhooks are used - we use cert-manager with strict webhook validation in prod, lower immediate risk.
carla: For cert-manager we run v1.8.0 on a few old clusters. Upgrading to v1.10.2 fixes CVE-2025-1183. Helm values change: controller.webhook.failurePolicy -> Fail -> default is Fail already but CRD validation version bump required. Will need to run `kubectl apply -f crds.yaml` before helm upgrade.
kevin: KMS note: cert-manager rotates issuer keys via secrets, which are encrypted with our KMS envelope. Upgrading cert-manager won't change KMS API, but if we change Secret API usage (stringData -> data) we need to confirm kek decryption flow in private deployments. Also RBAC: cert-manager upgrade will require read access to secrets for the controller SA; verify our RBAC manifests won't get tightened during the helm upgrade.
dave: @maria I can run a quick inventory of clusters that still on v1.8.0 and list affected clusters by tomorrow EOD.
secops: Audit logging question: if we roll kubelet changes, kubelet audit logs are sent to our central collector with node identity. Make sure we keep node-level audit forwarding enabled during the rolling restart so we don't blind ourselves. Also add a short policy to flag any abnormal auth attempts post-upgrade.
maria: Sounds good. Jonathan, prioritize kubelet patch. Carla, draft helm upgrade steps and a rollback plan. Kevin, confirm KMS secret access & RBAC diffs. Dave will inventory. We should decide: emergency window vs next maintenance window? What do folks think?
jonathan: Propose: kubelet patch is P1 for clusters running mixed-age nodes (older containerd + backported kernels). For fully-managed Dedicated clusters with strict SLA we can schedule a canary now on a low-traffic cluster; if successful, roll into maintenance window. So canary-first is safest.
carla: Agreed. For cert-manager we can batch to next maintenance window unless Dave finds a public-facing cluster still on 1.8.0. Helm steps (draft):
```
# pre-upgrade
kubectl apply -f https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/releases/download/v1.10.2/cert-manager.crds.yaml
helm repo update
helm upgrade --install cert-manager jetstack/cert-manager --namespace cert-manager --version v1.10.2 --wait
```
Rollback: helm rollback + restore secrets from last snapshot in s3 (we keep hourly for 24h).
kevin: For RBAC diffs here's a quick diff hint: controller-sa had clusterrolebinding with `secrets: get,list`. New chart expects `secrets: get,create,update`. We'll need to grant create in Dedicated -> confirm with security. Also private deployments might need a manual KMS policy tweak (IAM principal allowed to decrypt envelope).
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-cluster-3 at 2025-06-14T03:00Z, rollout policy: 10% nodes -> 30% -> 100% if health checks pass.
dave: Inventory: 3 prod clusters on 1.8.0 (prod-eu, prod-us-west-2, staging). Only prod-eu has webhooks exposed to third parties. I'll add that to the high-priority list.
secops: Also recommend enabling ephemeral audit retention override: set retention to 90d for the canary cluster during the test and add alerting rule `audit.events>100 and event.verb=="exec"` to catch suspicious escalation attempts.
maria: OK action items recap: Jonathan -> prepare kubelet canary patch playbook + smoke tests; Carla -> finalize cert-manager helm steps & rollback; Kevin -> RBAC/KMS confirmation; Dave -> complete inventory and mark prod-eu as high-priority; Secops -> temporary audit policy + alerts. Let's sync in #eng-oncall at 09:00 PST tomorrow for the go/no-go. :thumbsup:
jonathan: Will put playbook in docs/patch-playbooks/kubelet-2025-0451.md and share link in the morning.
carla: I'll post helm diff and `values.yaml` changes in this thread once ready.
maria: Thanks team - appreciate the quick responses. If anyone hits config drift when checking clusters ping me directly.
